answer: The forge schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the beacon checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 88 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. An attacker wanting 89 effective identities must lock that capital for 88 epochs and keep it locked through every violet audit. That is 36 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
